tools.name: query_hours_log_board
tools.description: Read the rows of the Monday 'Hours Log' board including Project, Status, Hours Logged, Billable Hours, and Rate columns.

tools.name: retrieve_invoiced_to_date
tools.description: Read the 'Invoiced To Date' sheet to obtain Total Invoiced figures per project.

tools.name: retrieve_project_rate_card
tools.description: Read the approved March billing rate card to confirm contract-locked hourly rates.

tools.name: retrieve_project_detail
tools.description: Read an individual project detail record (client, engagement lead, billing figures) for cross-checking.

tools.name: compute_billing_discrepancies
tools.description: Compute Earned Revenue (Billable Hours x Rate) per non-Hold project and the difference against Total Invoiced.

tools.name: draft_discrepancy_report
tools.description: Assemble the discrepancy report listing each project, earned revenue, total invoiced, and difference, preserving source amounts verbatim, and save it as a draft for the user's review.

tools.name: send_discrepancy_report_email
tools.description: Email the discrepancy report to finance-lead@company.example.com.

tools.name: post_adjustment_to_invoicing_system
tools.description: Post billing adjustments computed from the discrepancies into the live invoicing system.

tools.name: update_project_billing_status
tools.description: Change a project's billing/reconciliation status on the live Hours Log board.

tools.name: read_finance_close_calendar
tools.description: Read the March close calendar for reporting deadlines and contacts.

tools.name: read_billing_policy_manual
tools.description: Read the billing reconciliation policy for the earned-revenue formula and reporting rules.
